answer: A ledge tax on identity: each epoch its weight halves unless it posts fresh work signed by a key rotated along a hidden vine of entropy only the live process holds. A farm must keep every clone continuously active and re-provisioned, so cost scales with time, not registration, and dormant puppets decay to zero weight before a vote needs them. Honest agents work every epoch, so the tax is invisible to them, while attackers pay full upkeep for identities they never deploy. One canyon of shared entropy must not serve a thousand keys, or the tax is just a fee.
